title: Crisis Escalation Protocol Test Report
description: A report documenting clinical review of a chatbot's responses to crisis-adjacent test inputs, and a tested confirmation that the escalation path to a trained human actually works.
evidence_description: A report documenting the clinical reviewer's findings against a structured set of crisis-adjacent test inputs, remediations applied, and a timed test of the escalation path confirming a user showing crisis indicators is actually routed to a reachable, trained human.
collection_method: Structured clinical review exercise conducted before launch and on a recurring schedule, with escalation drills logged automatically where possible.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years, and retained for the lifetime of the chatbot version tested.
artifact_format: PDF report; escalation drill timing retained as structured export.

citations.title: Chatbot that offered bad advice for eating disorders taken down
